scope: Static review only; no source or profile edits made.

checks.evidence: BundledEntityIndex.swift:60-83 enters the audited occurrence path only when passage.book == ACT and an occurrences table exists. It obtains a legacy index point only for an ID in candidateMapIDs, then sets point = p.coordinate ?? candidate, so candidate coordinates are not written into the profile coordinate. The non-ACT lookup path starts at line 88 and remains a separate index-based path.

OfflineEntityPane.swift:12-16 filters out profiles whose materialCardIDs are already covered; the view also describes itself at line 5 as a supplement to reviewed material cards. The fallback map is reached only for an uncovered displayed occurrence whose profile coordinate is nil (lines 54-61).

checks.topic: Candidate map disclosure and share surface
checks.evidence: OfflineEntityPane.swift:54-61 displays the candidate map only when the reviewed profile has no coordinate and the indexed entity has a point. The link title explicitly says '従来資料の候補位置'. UnreviewedIndexedPlaceMap (lines 168-188) labels the point as a source candidate, says this app did not independently verify it, distinguishes regional/island/sea extents, names Theographic, and notes map network/current-location behavior. ShareViewController.swift:246-249 uses the same pane with inlineDetails=true; line 57 renders the same candidate map directly in that reading surface.

BundledEntityIndex.swift:56-58 loads acts-map-policy.json from Bundle.module only if present and silently leaves candidateMapIDs empty if absent. No acts-map-policy.json exists in candidate/apps/ios/Sources/Core/Resources (or elsewhere in the workspace). Package.swift processes the Resources directory, so the currently inspected source bundle cannot supply the policy. reviews/map-policy-place_1.json is review evidence, not the runtime resource, and covers only that reviewed subset. Consequently the runtime currently does not enable candidate coordinates, even when policy approval is otherwise recorded; if the resource is added later, the ID allow-list logic is correctly restrictive.

concerns.description: Add the finalized acts-map-policy.json to the processed Core Resources bundle before expecting approved candidate maps to appear. Validate resource inclusion and policy/profile/index ID alignment in the built app. This review did not edit or generate the policy.

limitations: This is a static source inspection, not an on-device or share-extension runtime test.
